title: Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated RCE on the XML-RPC endpoint, versions 4.0.0-6.1.4; Apache declares it exploited
content_md:
Apache Roller, CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated remote code execution on the XML-RPC endpoint, versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4. Apache says the flaw is being exploited.

via Mastodon https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/11/17/5
